misty-lake-shore.name: Misty Lake Shore
misty-lake-shore.description: A fog-covered shoreline at the forest's edge. Water- and plant-loving Digimon bring back more.

overgrown-server-ruins.name: Overgrown Server Ruins
overgrown-server-ruins.description: Ancient server racks swallowed by vines - scrap data and loose circuitry everywhere. Metal and Electric Digimon dig deeper.

beast-tracks.name: Beast Tracks
beast-tracks.description: Deep claw marks lead past Leomon's territory into the wild heart of the forest. Earth and Fire Digimon follow them best.
